episodeTitle.en: She turned 100+ rejections into a $42B company | Melanie Perkins
episodeTitle.zh: 《她将100多次拒绝转化为价值420亿美元的公司 | 梅兰妮·珀金斯》

guestBioOfficial.en: Melanie Perkins is CEO and co-founder of Canva, currently valued at over $42 billion, generating over $3 billion in annual revenue, with more than 240 million monthly active users and, incredibly, eight consecutive years of profitability. But the journey was far from smooth. Melanie was rejected by over 100 investors during her first fundraising round, her team spent two years without being able to ship a new feature during a technical rewrite, and the company pivoted early from a yearbook publishing platform to become the design powerhouse it is today. Through it all, she maintained what she calls “column B” thinking: building toward a dream future rather than just using the bricks around you. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 梅兰妮·珀金斯（Melanie Perkins）是市值超420亿美元的Canva公司的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司年营收超过30亿美元，月活跃用户超过2.4亿，最令人惊叹的是已连续八年实现盈利。但这条创业之路绝非一帆风顺：在首轮融资中，她被100多位投资者拒绝；团队在技术重构期间耗时两年未能推出新功能；公司还曾提前转型，从年鉴出版平台转向如今的顶级设计平台。历经种种挫折，她始终秉持所谓的“B列思维”——即不局限于现有资源，而是朝着梦想未来不断前行。

title.en: She turned 100+ rejections into a $42B company | Melanie Perkins
title.zh: 《她将100多次拒绝转化为价值420亿美元的公司 | 梅兰妮·珀金斯》

summary.en: Melanie recounts pitching over 100 investors who all said no, and turning each rejection into a new slide that sharpened her market thesis. She champions "crazy big goals" that make you feel inadequate and thus work harder to will them into existence. The episode is an inspiring founder story about persistence, vision, and betting on yourself.
summary.zh: 梅兰妮讲述了她向 100 多位投资人 pitch 却全部被拒，并把每一次拒绝变成一张新幻灯片、从而打磨出更清晰市场论点的经历。她推崇能让你自觉不足、从而更拼命去实现的"疯狂大目标"。本期是一则关于坚持、远见与押注自己的励志创始人故事。
